files.README.md:
# Hollowbrook Greenhouses - energy logs

Each floor's controller writes one CSV per day under data/readings/.
A current log is named floor<N>.csv and holds two columns with no
header row: an ISO timestamp and the watt-hours consumed in that
interval.

Two things to know about the logger:

- When a write times out the controller retries it, so the same
  reading can appear twice in a file. Readings are the same only when
  the whole line matches; count each reading once.
- floor2-old.csv is an archive left over from the old second-floor
  controller; it is not current data.
